Real fully transparent alpha background, pristine clean edges, no checkerboard, backdrop, floor, platform, pedestal or outside drop shadow. Do not add text, numerals, labels, seals, logos, watermarks, personal information, interface screenshots or medical/clinical symbols. No gratuitous accessories or patterns. The result is a decorative illustration, never a clickable control icon.
